title: Application Monitoring Zabbix Agent Entity
description: Zabbix agent configuration. Extends Application/Monitoring with Zabbix-specific settings.

server.description: Zabbix server address for passive checks.

server_active.description: Zabbix server address for active checks.

hostname.description: Hostname reported to the Zabbix server.

key.description: Item key for the custom check.

command.description: Shell command to execute for the check.

tls_connect.description: TLS connection mode to the Zabbix server.

tls_psk_identity.description: PSK identity string for TLS PSK encryption.
